name: status
title: Termius Status
description: Show login/cache state and inventory counts without syncing. Team accounts see cached team-key failures; diagnostics=true includes other cached cloud warnings.

diagnostics.description: Include other cached cloud warnings. Team-key warnings are shown only for team accounts. Default false.

name: login
title: Sign In to Termius
description: Sign in to Termius Cloud. method=email needs username and password (the vault encryption password). method=google returns a URL; after the user pastes termius://app/continue-sso?... call login_complete. Does not pull inventory; hosts/exec will auto-sync after a password is remembered.

otp.description: Authenticator / Authy code if 2FA is on

remember.description: Remember the vault password in the secret store (encrypted local state protected by a passphrase, OS keychain, or a local key). Default true.

name: login_complete
title: Finish Google Sign-In
description: Finish Google SSO. Pass the termius:// callback from login and the vault encryption password (not the Google password).

otp.description: Authenticator / Authy code if 2FA is on

remember.description: Remember the vault password in the secret store (encrypted local state protected by a passphrase, OS keychain, or a local key). Default true.

name: logout
title: Sign Out of Termius
description: Sign out, delete the remembered vault password, and wipe the local inventory.

name: sync
title: Sync Termius Vault
description: Force a cloud refresh now, or supply and remember a vault password. Other inventory and SSH tools already auto-sync; calling sync before each operation is unnecessary. Password comes from the argument, TERMIUS_VAULT_PASSWORD, or the secret store. Returns last_synced and counts.

password.description: Vault password if it is not remembered

remember.description: Remember the supplied password in the secret store. Default true.

name: hosts
title: List Hosts
description: List hosts. Filter with query; use limit/offset for large inventories. Without pagination, returns all matches. Refreshes after 600 seconds; a failed refresh returns cache with stale=true and sync_error. Use host for details, exec for SSH, files for SFTP.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive substring on label, address, group, or username

limit.description: Maximum matches to return. Omit for all. Pagination adds total, offset and next_offset (null at the end); count is this page's size.

offset.description: Skip this many matches after filtering. Default 0.

name: host
title: Host Details
description: One host plus merged SSH settings and a reference ssh(1) command when representable. agent_forwarding and the command use the account preference; native exec/files do not forward agents. Pulls when cache is older than 600 seconds; on failure returns stale local data. name is id or label. No passwords or private keys.

name.description: Host numeric id or exact label

name: exec
title: Run SSH Command
description: Execute a remote command over SSH using saved credentials and Host Chaining. Auto-syncs stale inventory (TERMIUS_SYNC_TTL; separate 120-second sync limit). Use max_output_chars for verbose commands. timeout closes the route and returns timed_out=true, exit_code=null and captured output; the remote process may continue. Returns stdout, stderr, exit_code and truncated. host_key_verification describes configured modes only when any endpoint is strict. Unspecified key checking is disabled; inherited true still verifies. Never echo unrequested secrets.

name.description: Host numeric id or exact label

max_output_chars.description: Characters to retain per stdout/stderr stream, default 200000. Use e.g. 16000 for logs or 0 for exit status only. A short marker indicates discarded output; execution still completes.

timeout.description: Total seconds for connect plus run (default 60)

name: files
title: SFTP Files
description: SFTP via saved credentials and Host Chaining. Auto-syncs stale inventory (TERMIUS_SYNC_TTL; separate 120-second sync limit). list supports limit/offset; stat returns metadata; read/write use inline text or base64 (max 200000 decoded bytes). get copies remote to local_path; put copies local_path to remote, streaming without a total-size cap or returning file content. mkdir/rm support recursive; rename needs dest. timeout covers SSH connection and transfer; raise it for large files. host_key_verification appears only when any endpoint is strict; it describes modes, not completed handshakes. Unspecified key checking is disabled; inherited true verifies. Never echo unrequested secrets.

name.description: Host numeric id or exact label

path.description: Remote path. Default . (login directory) for list

limit.description: list only: maximum entries to return. Omit for all. Adds total, offset and next_offset (null at the end); count is this page's size.

offset.description: list only: skip this many entries in the sorted listing. Default 0.

local_path.description: Path on the MCP host filesystem (get and put)

content.description: File text or base64 payload (write, at most 200000 decoded bytes; use put for larger files)

recursive.description: mkdir/write/put create parents; rm deletes a tree. Default false

timeout.description: Total seconds for connect plus transfer (default 60)

name: inventory
title: List Inventory
description: List groups, identities, keys or snippets; auto-syncs stale inventory (TERMIUS_SYNC_TTL). Identities and keys omit secrets. Use limit/offset for large lists and include_script=false to list snippets without their bodies. Defaults preserve full results.

include_script.description: Include snippet bodies. Default true; false returns snippet id/label only.

limit.description: Maximum items to return. Omit for all. Adds total, offset and next_offset (null at the end); count is this page's size.

offset.description: Skip this many visible items. Default 0.
